summary: Netflix is an American subscription video on-demand over-the-top streaming television service. The service primarily distributes original and acquired films and television shows from various genres. It is available internationally in multiple languages.

details.Area served: Worldwide (except China, Crimea , North Korea, Russia, and Syria)
details.Products: Streaming television video on demand digital distribution
details.Services: Film production film distribution television production television distribution
details.Launched: April 14, 1998 ; 28 years ago ( 1998-04-14 ) (as a DVD e-commerce) , January 16, 2007 ; 19 years ago ( 2007-01-16 ) (as a streaming service)
